label: Démons et créations 112
notes: Tall narrow pale/dark biped, TWO thin legs and TWO long tapered arm structures with the original hanging blade/cloth-like shapes. Preserve actual attachments and count from INPUT1, narrow pointed head and pale front; no invented bat wings or extra arms.
prompt: Draw the entire two-direction animation sheet for existing game creature MON-112-0 from these two identity references. Image 1 is its canonical FRONT at rest, image 2 is its old approximate rear and may be misleading. Preserve the exact anatomy and colors in image 1. Tall narrow pale/dark biped, TWO thin legs and TWO long tapered arm structures with the original hanging blade/cloth-like shapes. Preserve actual attachments and count from front identity reference, narrow pointed head and pale front; no invented bat wings or extra arms. Correct directional anatomy where necessary. Use fixed slightly elevated square-grid camera. EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equal cells, sixteen complete figures. FIRST TWO ROWS: eight poses all walking TOWARD the camera, down the screen. LAST TWO ROWS: eight poses all traveling AWAY, up the screen, viewed from behind. The rear must show true back or tail, not face, chest, or a flipped front. Preserve equipment on the same anatomical side and respect occlusion. Each two-row block is a short continuous cycle: first row support A, load A, swing B, settle B; second row support B, load B, swing A, settle A. For no-leg creatures interpret these as alternating travel phases of their original body. Keep the same scale, silhouette and head position, small grounded motion where appropriate. All 16 separate figures are drawn whole, centered and fully inside their respective cells, with generous gutters and outside margins. No text, lines, ground, shadows, white matte, glow or particles. Genuine transparent alpha outside every silhouette. Dark matte pixel clusters and original materials.
